title: Rehearsals and tempo changes in Blake's band
summary: Two-hour rehearsals and shifting waltz, foxtrot and one-step tempos under Blake's baton; popular dances included rhumba, foxtrot, tango.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: No deviations and that sort of thing. What were rehearsals like with Eubie Blake in the large band?

Well, we always would do about a two-hour rehearsal, rehearse to get the music straightened out and the tempos, the changed tempos and the... We'd play a little waltz tempo in some spots, and a foxtrot in the other ones, and one-stepping this and two-stepping this... Different tempos. And we've got to be able to... Because he directed with his baton.
Were schottisches still being played at that time? Schottisch rhythms?
Yes. Foxtrot. The popular things during that time were rhumbas and the foxtrot, and schottisches.
What about tangos? Were they popular at that time?
Yeah, the tango was very popular. The tango was a Spanish rhythm. [SINGS REFRAIN]
